items.title: Wyndham CEO Geoff Ballotti Diagnosed With Cancer: ‘Prognosis Is Favorable’
items.summary: Wyndham CEO Geoff Ballotti was diagnosed with "multiple myeloma, but it was caught "early" and his prognosis is "favorable. The 65-year-old executive will remain in his role while he undergoes treatment.

items.title: Premier Inn Owner Under Pressure: Sell Now, Demands Activist Investor
items.summary: Corvex isn't satisfied with Whitbread's April overhaul. Now it wants the whole company sold, and is threatening a board fight to force it.

items.title: The Vacation Rental Company Deflecting 60% of Guest Inquiries With AI
items.summary: Evolve has spent two years rebuilding its stack to make AI investments traceable directly to the P&L. Arun Nagarajan isn't theorizing about what AI could do for travel operations.

items.title: Expedia on Track for $350 Million Acquisition of CarTrawler: Scoop
items.summary: Expedia's outgoing chief financial officer said during its most recent earnings call that investments in its B2B unit could pressure margins near term. First Tiqets, and now CarTrawler, could be the investments he had in mind.

items.title: ‘Desperate’ to Travel, but Rising Costs Point to ‘Uneven’ Summer
items.summary: Outlooks and surveys project a busy summer for the travel industry, but climbing fuel prices likely mean bookings will be driven by higher-earning households.

items.title: Extreme Day Trips: Climate Costs and a Debate the Travel Industry Can’t Avoid
items.summary: The extreme daytripping debate has raised fresh concerns about the climate impacts of an industry that largely says it is committed to responsible tourism and reducing emissions.

items.title: Airbnb and Uber Want to Own More of Your Trip: History Says It Will Be Tough
items.summary: Both Airbnb and Uber have massive audiences. At first glance, expanding their travel offerings looks like an opportunity there for the taking. They will both need to prove it.
